blocks.text: Film Concerts PH brought UNDERTALE to life through a symphonic performance by the Filharmonika Orchestra at Proscenium Theater in Greenhills on October 17. The concert offered fans an immersive, nostalgic experience celebrating one of gaming’s most beloved cult classics. ‘UNDERTALE: The Determination Symphony’ took audiences on a musical playthrough of the game, with a 25-piece orchestra performing arrangements of its iconic soundtrack. The music was coordinated with the original game, created by independent game developer Toby Fox, bringing its memorable moments to life through a live orchestral experience.
